purpose: Stakeholder-friendly four-case set for deterministic versus frontier-assisted PoC A-F demo runs.

cases.why_included: Shows a clean successful end-to-end run through the bounded workflow using the sample receiving mismatch scenario.
cases.what_to_notice: The run completes cleanly with a receiving mismatch outcome, schema-aligned output, bounded validation metadata, and concise execution trace.

cases.why_included: Shows an obvious invoice exception where the PO anchor is unusable and the likely owner recommendation should be straightforward.
cases.what_to_notice: Both engines should identify the missing PO scenario clearly and keep the output reviewer-oriented without drifting into downstream action language.

cases.why_included: Shows a mixed-signal case where more than one issue looks plausible, making it the best discussion point for frontier-assisted judgment under ambiguity.
cases.what_to_notice: This is the strongest side-by-side case for discussing how each engine handles conflicting signals while staying inside the same bounded schema and trace contract.

cases.why_included: Shows bounded behavior when core triage anchors are incomplete and the system should stay cautious instead of over-claiming.
cases.what_to_notice: The audience should see uncertainty handled explicitly, with reviewer questions and restrained next actions instead of unsupported conclusions.
